name: Sable-Touched
text_md:
A sable-touched creature has spent too long in the shadowed planes and come back with some of them still clinging to it. Its colours are wrong, and its shadow arrives a heartbeat late.

"Sable-touched" is an acquired template that can be added to any living creature (referred to hereafter as the base creature). A sable-touched creature uses all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

modifications.text_md: The creature's type does not change. Size is unchanged. It gains the extraplanar subtype.
A sable-touched creature gains a +1 deflection bonus to AC.
A sable-touched creature retains all the special attacks of the base creature and gains shadow chill (see below).
A sable-touched creature retains all the special qualities of the base creature and gains shadow blend and darkvision out to 60 feet.
Change from the base creature as follows: Dex +2, Cha -2.
Usually one step toward evil from the base creature.

description_sections.heading: Creating a Sable-Touched Creature
description_sections.text_md: A living creature that spends a full month on a shadowed plane without magical protection becomes sable-touched. The change is permanent and cannot be reversed by anything short of a miracle.
